input: Owner asked: study why calculators got prioritized (report + blog post + fix), make the site findable (robots.txt), check if a self-hosted visitor count is possible, consolidation direction, merchant-of-record candidates.
errors: GitHub App returned 403 on POST /user/repos, so the duncan-haywood.github.io user-site repo (robots.txt fix) could not be created; files staged in platform/pages/user-site/ for the owner's one-click repo creation.

doc_friction.issue: DEFAULT_BASE_URL is https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/ but the repository is now named oss-monorepo; if Pages moved with the rename, every canonical tag and sitemap entry points at a dead path. Sessions cannot fetch github.io to check (proxy 403).
'New ventures get first call' (2026-09-06) was still printed by session_gate.py on every PROCEED verdict after the owner's 2026-10-15 no-new-calculators rule; prose and gate disagreed.
check_input_bounds.py and gitops/tests/test_ci_runner.py (2 tests) are red on main; any PR touching nothing near them inherits a red validate job.

deviations.why: Did not add an unattended workflow to commit visitor counts (Automation rule); pull.mjs is run by sessions instead.
Recorded without --model: this session's instructions forbid model identifiers in pushed artifacts.

notes: Shipped: platform/counter (first-party cookieless visitor counter, off until deployed), family-aware router ranking (bid calculators in top 100: 63 -> 3), session-gate wording, calculator-glut report and blog post, owner direction in goals.md. Not done: score_ventures.py merit penalties, unscored-as-0, consolidation itself.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: history study across 11.7k commits, counter server+tests, router change, two documents

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
